subject: integration conflict: apps/web/src/assistant/ask.ts, config/app_config.yaml, packages/shared/openapi.j
body:
Rebase onto claude/naadi-shared conflicted in:
- apps/web/src/assistant/ask.ts
- config/app_config.yaml
- packages/shared/openapi.json
- packages/shared/src/gen/index.ts
- packages/shared/src/gen/types.gen.ts
- packages/shared/src/gen/zod.gen.ts
- packages/shared/ui-copy.defaults.json

Recent integration commits touching them:
fix(library): restore the S15 ui_copy keys in REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS lost in a merge; regenerate shipped defaults
fix(ingest): prefix the ingest API models (IngestOptionOut, IngestCounts, ...) so they never collide with other segments' OpenAPI names
feat(library): Library page, confirm and Vault cards, PDF viewer with ink per page (S15 web)
docs: ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY (threat model, CSP, rate limits, ASVS 4.0.3 L2), CONTENT_GUIDE, RUNBOOK ops; SearXNG admin probe
feat(video): the official player runs on a separate-origin static Space (deploy/player-space), exact origin checks both ways, one config value for CSP, Permissions-Policy and the iframe; deploy script and workflow; speed label contrast; real-YouTube @live spec
fix(generation): review fixes - client cannot delete rows (0029 soft hide, server-only pause, failed runs count), names refused, Space validates before the GPU, submit inside try, service worker URL through a Trusted Types policy
feat(web): question review UI, Settings shell with Data & export, Study plan, Appearance, About & privacy; e2e specs and helpers
feat(pathway): cost_entry placement for ingest (fee receipt -> cost proposal, applied only after confirm)
chore: contracts
feat(pathway): stages with Re-verify, task progress and costs (LWW), document vault, weekly official-page check (migration 0028)
fix(ingest): restore backup/prune graphs next to ingest in aegra.json after the rebase; migration 0028 down 0026 (chain 0025 -> 0027 -> 0026 -> 0028); contracts regenerated
feat(ingest): universal ingest + knowledge base backend (S15)
feat(search): self-hosted SearXNG in the Space image (layer 8 stays off), loopback health component
feat(ops): encrypted nightly backups + weekly Storage tarball, tested restore, daily prune, backup health (migration 0026)
feat(planner): week calendar, deterministic rebalance with confirm, ICS feed, Web Push reminders (migration 0027)

My branch is unchanged (rebase aborted).
